notes: Historical fiscal-year mapping: the JSON keys 2023–2025 correspond to NVIDIA fiscal years ended Jan 29 2023, Jan 28 2024, and Jan 26 2025, respectively. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm))

EBIT is defined as operating income from NVIDIA’s Consolidated Statements of Income (not interest-adjusted EBIT). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm))
D&A is taken from the cash flow line 'Depreciation and amortization'. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm))

Capex is defined as 'Purchases related to property and equipment and intangible assets' from the cash flow statement, which may not exactly match management’s separately stated 'capital expenditures' metric. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm))

NWC construction: (Accounts receivable + Inventories + Prepaid expenses and other current assets) - (Accounts payable + Accrued and other current liabilities). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm))

Tax rate: base-case tax_rate=0.13 is a normalized effective rate derived from FY2025 and FY2024 income tax expense / income before income tax. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm))

NOL balance: set to the sum of federal + state + foreign NOL carryforwards disclosed as of Jan 26, 2025 (479m + 332m + 349m). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/nvda-20250126.htm)) Utilization percent is set to the provided default (0.80) due to limited disclosed bridge-to-utilization detail.

WACC: discount rate input uses GuruFocus WACC% as of 2026-03-21; actual internal WACC in a full build may differ depending on beta, ERP, capital structure weights, and tax assumptions. ([gurufocus.com](https://www.gurufocus.com/term/wacc/NVDA))

Terminal exit multiple: terminal_exit_ebitda_multiple=28.5 is set to the peer median EV/NTM EBITDA multiple from an accessible comparable set; it is used as an approximation for an economically consistent steady-state EBITDA exit multiple. ([readybase.ai](https://readybase.ai/home_examples/nvda/nvda.pdf))
Current price: set from market data feed at 2026-03-21 (USD/share).

catalysts: Continued ramp and demand capture for next-generation platforms (e.g., Rubin-related announcements and platform progression). ([investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))
Changes to AI infrastructure spending rates (hyperscaler/enterprise capex) that could accelerate or decelerate revenue growth vs the base-case fade. (Model sensitivity)
Geopolitical/export control developments that can alter regional revenue availability and supply-chain execution. (Risk/catalyst)
company_overview: World leader in AI and accelerated computing, operating through the Compute & Networking and Graphics segments. ([investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))

Compute & Networking provides data center accelerated computing and networking platforms plus AI solutions/software; Graphics provides GPUs for gaming and enterprise workstation graphics. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nvda/))

Fiscal 2026 results showed strong operating profitability and continued platform-driven demand, with GAAP operating income of $130.387B for the year. ([investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))
current_context: FY2026 revenue was $215.938B (up 65% y/y) and GAAP operating income was $130.387B. ([investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))

Q4 FY26 revenue was $68.127B (up 73% y/y) with GAAP operating income of $44.299B. ([investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))

Q1 FY27 guidance: revenue expected at $78.0B (±2%); full-year FY27 GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates expected between 0.17 and 0.19 (excluding discrete items/material changes). ([investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base-case connects the demand outlook to multi-year AI infrastructure build-out and continued product/platform transitions (Blackwell and next-gen roadmap). ([investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))
Model profitability thesis assumes margin normalization from FY2026 levels toward a ~45% terminal EBIT margin rather than sustained peak margins. (Base-case assumption)

Relative valuation check: accessible comp set indicates NVDA commands a premium on EV/NTM Revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA versus several large-cap semiconductor peers. ([readybase.ai](https://readybase.ai/home_examples/nvda/nvda.pdf))
key_risks: Revenue growth may undershoot if AI infrastructure spending slows or customer inventory digestion occurs faster than modeled. (Model risk)
Margins may compress more than assumed due to competitive pricing pressure or a mix shift toward lower-margin products. (Model risk)
Export controls and geopolitical constraints could directly impact addressable market and timing of shipments. (Risk)
